name: Quest Intents
vision_statement: The AI works from the person's quests.
opportunities: A representative works across many quests, so the standing view it needs is wider than any one request: past conversations, recent context, the guidance learned from corrections, the ledger of what was asked, the predictions made and the person's long-term goal. That opens questions the parent solution does not ask: how a correction is kept in the person's own words and tracked until it is followed, how a view is held per quest, per intent and per representative without crossing scopes, how a reply is aimed at the person's end without hijacking a simple question, and which representative a request runs as, the same way in chat, tasks and background work.
solution_coherence: Quest Intents keeps the person's quests as the standing view every request is read against. Long-Term Memory keeps what was said across conversations and says what bears on a request. Recall Recent Context hands the next turn the cards its last turns already found. Guidance ties the work to its purpose by framing the intent a quest sits under. Guide Toward The Long-Term Goal points a reply at the quest's next milestone without nagging.
